name: Malta End of Summer 2025

venue.name: [The University of Malta](https://www.um.edu.mt/)
venue.details: KSU-PWC Common Room, Student’s House, University of Malta MSD2080

information: Welcome to the third official WCA competition in Malta! Please check all tabs, especially [if you are a new competitor](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MaltaEndofSummer2025#55260-for-new-competitors). Please also check the [competition schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MaltaEndofSummer2025#competition-schedule) in the dedicated tab, as the competition will start in the early morning with some advanced events, be interrupted for a few hours by [FMC Europe 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MaltaEndofSummer2025#63651-fmc-europe-2025) and continue in the afternoon with the most popular events.
